blinding_guess.why: The package is listed as providing COMMAND_ACK (command, result), but at this revision the firmware never emits COMMAND_ACK: both 'send any requested ACKs' branches in commander are '// XXX TODO', even though COMMAND_LONG.confirmation is consumed and forwarded into vehicle_command. A peer that waits for COMMAND_ACK gets none.

notes: MAVLink is not ROS: no .msg/.srv definitions exist for these elements. The firmware's MAVLink C headers live in the submodule mavlink/include/mavlink/v1.0, which is empty in the snapshot; MAVLink XML is not a permitted fetch type and ros_distro is null, so definition_id is null for every port and QoS is null (ROS1 rule; MAVLink has no QoS). The HEARTBEAT.autopilot field type (uint8_t) is taken from Tools/mavlink_px4.py, a host-side pymavlink binding generated from common.xml that nothing in the snapshot imports; it lacks COMMAND_INT, so it predates the headers the firmware compiles against. The type is therefore medium-confidence. The same binding defines COMMAND_ACK (command uint16_t, result uint8_t) at Tools/mavlink_px4.py:1650-1662; I did not count that as the firmware declaring COMMAND_ACK, because no firmware code builds or sends it. COMMAND_LONG is also transmitted by the package (MavlinkStreamCommandLong forwards vehicle_command for other systems, stream configured at 100 Hz at mavlink_main.cpp:1654-1655; CAMERA_CAPTURE stream sends COMMAND_LONG with confirmation = 0 at mavlink_messages.cpp:2420-2435); the port keeps the packet side 'consumes' and rate_hz stays null because the 100 Hz applies to the outgoing stream. COMMAND_INT handler ignores the message's frame field (cmd_mavlink.frame is never read) and does not set vcmd.confirmation, so ports[2].frame is null. COMMAND_LONG params pass through unchanged and may carry positions depending on the command; the code declares no frame, so ports[3].frame is null. handle_message_set_mode sets vcmd.confirmation = 1 (mavlink_receiver.cpp:552). Commander checks cmd->confirmation > 0 (commander.cpp:917, 3413) but the ack send is a TODO. HEARTBEAT: const_rate() returns true (mavlink_messages.cpp); no ROMFS/posix-config script changes the HEARTBEAT rate (grep 'HEARTBEAT' in ROMFS and posix-configs: 0 hits). exclusive: no exclusive device claims in the mavlink/commander paths (serial opened O_RDWR | O_NOCTTY at mavlink_main.cpp:664).
